title: Verizon champions the innovators of tomorrow, names winner of Verizon Frontline App Developer Challenge
snippet: NEW YORK, May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Continuing a decades-long commitment to driving innovation in public safety, emergency response and community resilience, Verizon today announced the winner of its first-ever Verizon Frontline App Developer Challenge.
